study_metadata.target_context: SITES Nuolja Field Research Station, Abisko, Sweden

evidence_sources.name: POLARIS_v0_1_SITES_Nuolja_2024_hourly_5var.csv
evidence_sources.target_relevance: Direct weather telemetry from Nuolja Middle Station (SW_IN, Temp, Wind). Contains ZERO battery hardware or BMS telemetry.
evidence_sources.evidence_findings: Confirms site is an atmospheric field station.

evidence_sources.name: POLARIS_EMS_MINIMUM_SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE.json
evidence_sources.target_relevance: Defines synthetic 200.0 kWh / 50.0 kW BESS fixture for MILP algorithm benchmarking. Explicitly sets real_nuolja_data: false.
evidence_sources.evidence_findings: Synthetic reference, NOT physical target hardware.

evidence_sources.name: Swedish Polar Research Secretariat Site Infrastructure Catalog
evidence_sources.target_relevance: Station infrastructure inventory for Abisko Scientific Research Station & Nuolja field sites.
evidence_sources.evidence_findings: No utility-scale (200 kWh) BESS asset listed for Nuolja Middle Station.

evidence_sources.name: NREL / Academic Lithium-Ion Aging Literature (Wang 2011, Schmalstieg 2014)
evidence_sources.target_relevance: Provides semi-empirical degradation equation structures (Q_loss = A * exp(-Ea/RT) * t^z + B * Ah).
evidence_sources.evidence_findings: Supports model structure ONLY. Cannot parameterize unestablished Nuolja hardware.
